lines.t: (Intro)
(Soft, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, intimate breathing)
(Sigh)
I kept thinking if I stayed long enough,
I’d be the lamp in the room that changed the shade of the walls.
I thought if I just held on, I’d pull you up...
But I was just sinking with you.
(Verse 1)
Sitting at the table with the silence in the air
Tryna trade my conviction for a seat upon a chair
You look at what I hold like a fever in my mind
And I keep tryna force a blind man to see the signs
How am I supposed to teach a language to the deaf?
I’ve been pouring out my spirit 'til I got nothing left
Trying to heal a tongue that doesn't want to speak the name
Staying in the shadow, hoping I won't catch the blame.
(Pre-Chorus)
Light and the dark, they don't share the same room
I'm trying to grow, but you’re planting a tomb
It’s not out of hate, it’s the weight of the call
I can't keep on reaching if it makes us both fall.
(Chorus)
So I’m done running back to the place where I bleed
Trying to buy what I don't really need
I’m walking away, yeah, I’m letting it go
Leaving the field where nothing can grow
I love you enough to stop fighting the stone
I’m stepping outside... and I’m walking alone.
(Verse 2 - Spoken Word / Raw Rap)
(Guitar rhythm gets slightly firmer, vocal becomes direct, fast, poetic, and honest)
Look, I kicked against the rock 'til my feet were both broken
Hanging onto every harsh word that was spoken
Thinking if I loved you hard enough, you’d see the vision
But you can't force a heart to make a spirit decision
What fellowship does light have walking through the night?
How am I supposed to fix what isn't mine to fight?
You call it a wedge, I call it a border
I was trying to bring peace to a house out of order
We’re yoked at the neck, but we’re pulling apart
You’re dragging me down to the dark in your heart
I’m not playing the savior, I’m dropping the mask
I was asking for fruit from a tree made of ash.
I limped away wounded every time that I tried
To keep something alive that already had died.
(Pre-Chorus)
Light and the dark, they don't share the same room
I'm trying to grow, but you’re planting a tomb
It’s not out of hate, it’s the weight of the call
I can't keep on reaching if it makes us both fall.
(Chorus)
So I’m done running back to the place where I bleed
Trying to buy what I don't really need
I’m walking away, yeah, I’m letting it go
Leaving the field where nothing can grow
I love you enough to stop fighting the stone
I’m stepping outside... and I’m walking alone.
(Bridge)
(Music strips back to just a quiet guitar strumming and raw vocal)
It hurts to leave the doorway open...
It hurts to turn my back and walk...
But I can't stay down in the valley
Just to listen to you talk...
I pray you find the light one day,
But I can't be the price you pay.
(Outro)
(Slow fingerpicking, fading ambient sound)
No more running back...
No more pulling the weight...
I’m letting you go.
I'm finally whole.
